candidate_semantic_classification.assessment: This guard coordinates a new truncate request with an in-progress block recovery. The exact dynamic dependency across client, NameNode, and DataNode is not inferred solely from this source check.
candidate_semantic_classification.basis: newLength == truncateLength for a block UNDER_RECOVERY
candidate_semantic_classification.label: truncate_recovery_length_guard

coverage_metric_note: JaCoCo probe identities and production method/line coverage are exact; branch_counts are per-method covered branch counts, used as monotone feedback. Runtime-generated Mockito mock classes are excluded.
elapsed_seconds_semantics: One healthy JUnit plus each actual fault-trial JUnit, including selector retries.
source_review: FSDirTruncateOp.truncate compares a second requested length with the length already being truncated while the last block is UNDER_RECOVERY. Equal lengths return an idempotent result; different lengths raise AlreadyBeingCreatedException. TestFileTruncate#testTruncateTwiceTogether deliberately requests a different length and expects that exception. A new post-fault length/state pair needs replay and source review.
target_code: newLength == truncateLength for a block UNDER_RECOVERY
